svg.text: The 12th drop of 10%+ from a 52-week high since 2016 — and what came next
Confirmation = first close 10%+ below the trailing 52-week closing high; a new episode requires recovering to within 5% first.
Returns use trading-day offsets (5 / 21 / 63 / 126 / 252). Latest row: episode still open.
